$comment: The commits build.py makes, as a base and the features forked from it. Format: a JSON object with 'base' and 'features'. 'base' is the root commit: 'branch' (the base branch, main), 'source' (the directory next to build.py whose files form the commit's tree), 'author' ('name' and 'email', also the committer), 'date' (ISO 8601 with offset) and 'message'. Each entry of 'features' is one feature: 'id', 'title', 'owner' (an id from penguin/owners.json), 'role' ('originating' for the feature whose change the others must absorb, 'running' for a feature already under way), 'fork' (the branch that holds the feature, forked from the base branch), 'area' (the 'scopes', 'paths' and 'contracts' the feature declares when it opens; a contract is one main's penguin/scopes.json declares, so a contract the feature adds is declared in its fork's penguin/scopes.json, not here), 'author' and 'commits'. Each commit lays the files of its 'source' directory over the fork's tree; 'tag' names a lightweight tag on the commit. 'plan': true marks the originating feature's checkpoint its agent proposes the merge plan at; without it, the plan is proposed at the feature's first commit. The first commit of a feature starts from the base branch, each later one from the fork's previous commit.

base.message:
Base: ingestion, shared date helpers, analytics and messaging

Three scopes owned by priya, jun and sam, declared in penguin/scopes.json with their
contracts. penguin/invariants.json declares the analytics and messaging invariants and
the recorded examples of the daily batches.

features.title: Start each day at UTC midnight in start_of_day

commits.message:
Start each day at UTC midnight in start_of_day

Two devices that record one instant with different UTC offsets now put their
events into the same daily ingestion batch.

Add start_of_local_day to the shared date helpers

Returns the midnight of a user's local day at the user's UTC offset, for code that
groups or schedules by the user's own calendar. Declares it as an ingestion contract.

Add the weekly activity report

Counts each user's events on the seven days of a week, by the user's local day.
Declares weekly_report as an analytics contract with recorded examples.

Bucket the weekly report with start_of_local_day

start_of_day now returns a UTC midnight, which moves evening activity west of UTC
onto the next day.

Add reminder scheduling

Schedules each contact's next reminder at a local hour of the contact's day.
Declares next_reminder and reminder_times as messaging contracts with recorded
examples.

Schedule reminders from start_of_local_day

start_of_day now returns a UTC midnight, which moves a reminder west of UTC off
the contact's local hour.
